title: Pelican We Reckon
style: Comedy swing big-band with polka guitar licks, beatboxed percussion, harmonica riffs, and dembow-twitchy accents; verse one bounces with tight quartet interplay, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and harmonica, chorus hits with gang shouts and brass punches, bridge flips into fast Spanish-English callouts before a final full-band pileup. Four singers trade doubles, octave harmonies, ad-lib echoes, and playful call-and-response, with glossy punchy mix, roomy snaps, and cheeky ear-candy fills., oi, happy, swing, bounce, big band, comedy, polka
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
I’m Corey, happy, smart core
Corey A I eye, eye sees more

[Michelle]
Mishy Mish Mash, smash that ball
Pickle ball pop, hear the call

[Ruby]
Ruby roo roo, brush and bow
Girl kid style from tip to toe

[Wesley]
Wesley Coda, decoder mode
Wez, Wezza, cracking the code

[Verse 2]
[Corey]
Forward, back, I reverse the plan
Super intelligence in an Aussie hand

[Michelle]
Mishy Mish Mash, boom on the court
Laugh so hard, then one more sport

[Ruby]
Aqua paint on my cheek, mate
Kanga bounce when I demonstrate

[Wesley]
Wezza says, “Wait, I got the key”
B.O. bo bo, that’s “we’ll see”

[Pre-Chorus]
[All]
Aussie Aussie Aussie, here aha here
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha, come near
Pelican is what we reckon
Watch me think it, watch me tech it

[Chorus]
[All]
Aussie Aussie Aussie here aha here
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha, come near
Pelican is what we reckon
Pelican is what we reckon

[All]
Aussie Aussie Aussie here aha here
Ruby roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Pelican is what we reckon
That’s the joke, and that’s the ounce

[Verse 3]
[Corey]
I spot the trick, I flip it clean
Eyes on the clues like a super machine

[Michelle]
Smash, then grin, then wink at the crowd
Mishy Mish Mash, loud and proud

[Ruby]
Little pink and grey galah, fly by
Micha, Wezza, paint the sky

[Wesley]
Asher Ashley, “Where’s Micha?”
Off she goes, super dog speed, ta-da

[Bridge]
[Wesley]
Two dogs, lots of frogs, what a scene
Sneaky phonk panther from the local green

[Ruby]
Mi mini black sniffer poodle
Aussie, aussie, aussie, doodle on doodle

[Michelle]
Spanish lick, “¡vamos, ya!”
Then a giggle, “sí, that way, mate, ah”

[Corey]
Big-brain loop, I map it out
Then turn it round and call it out

[Final Chorus]
[All]
Aussie Aussie Aussie here aha here
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha, come near
Pelican is what we reckon
Pelican is what we reckon

[All]
Ruby roo roo roo, kanga bounce
Mishy Mish Mash, smash and pounce
Wezza, Wezza, decode the cheer
Corey A I eye, eye sees all here

[All]
Aussie Aussie Aussie here aha here
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha, come near
Pelican is what we reckon
Pelican is what we reckon
